body.statement: If the uniform multiplier-coupling question has an affirmative resolution, then the ridge-totalized single hull \(C_n\), defined on every sample and allowed to be empty, satisfies \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}\inf_{P\in\mathcal P_n^{\mathrm{ct}}(C_{\delta})\cup\mathcal P^{\mathrm{int}}(\delta_0)}P\{\Theta_I(P)\subseteq C_n\}\geq1-\eta\). Moreover, under the stated empty-set convention for \(d_{\to}\), \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_n^{\mathrm{ct}}(C_{\delta})}E_P[d_{\to}(C_n,\Theta_I(P))]=O(n^{-1/4})\) and \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P^{\mathrm{int}}(\delta_0)}E_P[d_{\to}(C_n,\Theta_I(P))]=O(n^{-1/2})\), with the same statistic and critical-value rule.
body.justification: The result couples honest whole-set coverage with automatic fourth-root-to-root-\(n\) geometric adaptation.
body.gap: Romano--Shaikh deliver uniform whole-set coverage and Chernozhukov--Newey--Santos deliver constrained-model bootstrap validity, but neither gives the adaptive loss frontier for this quadratic-contact identified interval.
body.consumer: Applied sensitivity analyses receive one confidence hull that remains valid without diagnosing whether the empirical leakage constraint is nearly binding.
